name: Up Your Sleeve
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round per level

DESCRIPTION

Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or sonic.

Each time you deal damage before the end of your next turn, the damage becomes the type you chose.
